name: list_toolbar_threads
description:
List Vercel toolbar comment threads for a team. Returns unresolved threads by default. Use this to see feedback, comments, or discussions on deployments and previews.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} --cwd {linkedProjectPath} comments --all-branches. Fill placeholders from inputs.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 20.

page.description: Filter by page path (e.g. /docs) or glob (e.g. /docs*)

status.description: Filter by status. Defaults to unresolved.

teamId.description:
The ID or slug of the team that owns the resource.
Team IDs start with "team_".
If you do not know the team ID or slug, it can be found through these mechanism:
- Read the file .vercel/project.json if it exists and extract the orgId
- Use the `list_teams` tool
